about: Lewiston House of Pizza is a family pizza and Greek restaurant at 95 Lincoln Street in Lewiston, Maine, with catering and banquet rooms.
menu_note: The shop's current menu and prices are on its own website (lewistonhouseofpizza.net). This concept does not reproduce them: call (207) 786-2020 for items and prices.
findings: One-page vendor template (footer credit to eztouse.com) with a footer still reading ©2022.
Only nav items are Home and Privacy Notice; catering, banquet rooms and the menu have no pages of their own.
Confusing history: the page title says 'Best Pizza Since 2002' while the copy says 'Since 1998'. This concept states neither year.
Ordering is split between an unlabeled Slice icon and a Google Play link to a ChowNow app, with no single Order button.
Every image has an empty alt attribute; daily specials say 'Fries of O-Rings'.
questions: Which year did the shop open, 1998 or 2002?
Is the Slice link the one ordering path you want customers to use?
What do you offer for catering and what size are the banquet rooms?
